title: Ban cap nhat v1.8.4 - Che do chuyen doi Toggle View (Card Thong Tin & Bang Co Dien)
releaseNotes:
- Bo sung che do Toggle View giua 'Bang + Man hinh' truyen thong va 'Card Thong Tin' hien dai
- O che do Card Thong Tin: An bang tren de giai phong 100% chieu cao, mo rong panel ben phai moi view de hien thi day du Mail, Pass, User, Name, IP, Status va nut Chay/Dung
- Tu dong dong bo du lieu theo thoi gian thuc va luu che do vao config
